shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'SKILL.md' -g '*lock*' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'components/**' -g 'index.html' -g 'vite.config.*' -g 'README*'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 3 'markdown|editor' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"
/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat AGENTS.md && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!'"\\.git'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && cat tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor version peerDependencies && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch SegmentedRadioGroup Label'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor'

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch SegmentedRadioGroup Label Text Modal && rg -n 'color-base-(background|float|generic)|color-text-(primary|secondary|hint)|color-line-generic|spacing-' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -35"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -180 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -150 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts | head -85'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/components@4.23.0 peerDependencies && npm view @gravity-ui/components@4.20.0 peerDependencies'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor @gravity-ui/components@4.23.0'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -95 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts | head -70'
/bin/bash -lc 'rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor | head -30'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/INDEX.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides/how-to-add-preview.md'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/index.d.ts && rg -n 'RenderPreview|interface MarkdownEditor|interface UseMarkdown|initial|splitMode|toolbar' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/view/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/*.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json | head -100 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -12"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts | head -190 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/editor-public-types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/events.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/view/index.d.ts && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(Arrow|Book|CircleQuestion|Check|Gear|Eye|Globe|File|Chevron|CircleInfo|PaperPlane|Bolt|Triangle|Link|Layout|Moon|Sun)' | head -55 && cat node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/package.json | head -90"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@diplodoc/transform | rg '(transform|index)\\.(d\\.ts|js)"'$'"' | head -22 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/view/components/YfmHtml/YfmStaticView.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/preset-base-types.d.ts | head -70 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/Editor.d.ts | head -100 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/common/types/editor.d.ts 2>/dev/null && rg -n 'transform|browser' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/index.d.ts | head -125 && head -60 node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/index.js && rg --files node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/dist | head -30 && rg -n 'getValue|replace|setValue' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/common -g '*.d.ts' && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '"'^node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/(BookOpen|CircleQuestion|Check|Gear|Eye|Globe|FileText|ArrowChevronRight|ArrowLeft|CircleInfo|PaperPlane|Clock|ArrowUpRight|SquarePlus)'"\\.d.ts"'$'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'transform|markdown-it' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/utils/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/core/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/view/components/index.d.ts && cat vite.config.ts && head -65 node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/md.js && rg -n 'allowHTML|needToSanitizeHtml|disableLiquid|plugins' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/typings.d.ts | head -22 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat vite.config.ts; head -65 node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/md.js; rg -n 'allowHTML|needToSanitizeHtml|disableLiquid|plugins' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/typings.d.ts | head -22; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/markup/index.d.ts | head -50"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/icons @diplodoc/transform'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkupEditorView.css | head -100 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.css | head -80 && rg -n 'horizontal|vertical' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkupEditorView.js"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'browser|transform' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm -g '*transform*.d.ts' -g '*Transform*.d.ts' | head -35; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides/how-to-add-editor-with-create-react-app.md | head -110; rg -n 'process|require\\(\"(fs|path|url|util|crypto|stream|node:)' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/plugins/utils.js; cat node_modules/markdown-it/package.json | head -65; cat src/main.tsx; cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '110,190p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides/how-to-add-editor-with-create-react-app.md; cat node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/utilsFS.js | head -100; rg -n 'process\\.|process_\\d|punycode|utilsFS' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/liquid.js node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/plugins/utils.js node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/plugins/includes/index.js; rg --files node_modules/@diplodoc/transform | rg 'bundle|browser|client'"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e 'const fs=require(\"fs\");let p=\"src/main.tsx\";let s=fs.readFileSync(p,\"utf8\").replace(\"import { ThemeProvider }\", \"import { configure, ThemeProvider }\").replace(\"ReactDOM.createRoot\", \"configure({lang: \\\"ru\\\"});\\n\\nReactDOM.createRoot\");fs.writeFileSync(p,s);p=\"index.html\";s=fs.readFileSync(p,\"utf8\").replace(\"lang=\\\"en\\\"\",\"lang=\\\"ru\\\"\").replace(/<title>.*?<\\/title>/,\"<title>Новая публикация · Страницы</title>\");fs.writeFileSync(p,s);'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'punycode' node_modules/markdown-it/lib/index.js; rg -n 'process\\.|process\\[' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib -g '*.js' | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/styles/styles.css | head -50; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/_light.scss 2>/dev/null | head -10; git status --short; rg -n -- '--g-color-base-misc-light|--g-color-line-warning|--g-border-radius-xl|--g-font-family-monospace|--g-md-editor-padding' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/styles | head -22"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'punycode' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/typings.d.ts; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg '(variables|variables\\.css|themes.*css|styles\\.css)"'$'"' | head -20; npm ls punycode; rg -n 'platform|process|resolve|dirname|basename' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/plugins/links/index.js node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/plugins/images/index.js node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/utils.js | head -35"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install punycode && npm install -D @types/node'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '90,170p' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/md.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/common/spacing.scss | head -70; rg -n -- 'font-family-monospace|border-radius-xl|color-line-warning' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -8; sed -n '30,60p' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/typings.d.ts; head -60 node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/plugins/index.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/toolbar/presets/commonmark.js 2>/dev/null | head -30"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install -D vite-plugin-node-polyfills'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'include:|exclude:|protocolImports|globals:' node_modules/vite-plugin-node-polyfills/README.md | head -95; cat package.json; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/toolbar/types.d.ts | head -90; rg -n -- '--g-md-editor-padding|--g-md-toolbar-padding' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/styles/styles.css | head -8"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && cat src/main.tsx'
